rules: All sixteen numbered exhibits use a colon caption - 'Figure N: <noun phrase>' and 'Table N: <noun phrase>' - including the two grids whose captions end in full stops and the one whose caption absorbed the next sentence of prose [caption.numbering] [caption.verbatim].

The caption side splits by exhibit type exactly once: Table 1's caption prints ABOVE its grid (caption y 369.6 over bbox y 385.9) and every other caption prints BELOW its artwork, settled from PyMuPDF word coordinates against the measured bbox [caption.position].

No caption gives a unit, a variable, a condition or a conclusion, and voice is 'none' on all sixteen; the one caption that carries a clause ('where n is the order of the matrix.') carries it because the text layer welded the following prose sentence onto the caption line [caption.units] [caption.variables] [caption.conditions] [caption.concludes] [caption.voice] [caption.verbatim].
Caption lengths run 2 to 8 words for the figures and 2 to 13 for the grids, and every caption is a single sentence apart from Table 2's welded clause [caption.words] [caption.sentences].

Pointing is again never subject-first in the main: twelve of sixteen rows use a locative clause ('shown in Fig. N', 'in Fig. N, we compare', 'shown in Tab. N'), two use a parenthetical '(Fig. 3)', and only two make the exhibit the subject - 'Fig. 7 illustrates the relationship among customers...' and 'Fig. 10 shows the change of ICM Corporation utility as time passes' [mention.lead_pattern] [mention.style] [mention.lead_sentence].

The paper abbreviates its pointers as 'Fig.' and 'Tab.' in the prose while the captions spell 'Figure' and 'Table' out in full, so every row's style list holds the abbreviated spelling and never the caption spelling [mention.style].

Two exhibits are announced a page before they print: Figure 5 ('This process is shown in Fig. 5.' at the foot of p15) and Figure 7 ('Fig. 7 illustrates...' in 5.2's opening paragraph on p17); the other fourteen are announced on their exhibit's own page [mention.first_page] [mention.lead_pages].

One exhibit is never mentioned anywhere in twenty-two pages: Table 1, the notation list. Section 2.2 simply opens and the grid follows, so its first_page is null, its count is 0 and its lead_pattern is 'none' [mention.count] [mention.first_page].

Only three rows carry a reading sentence and all three readings are printed on the near side of the plate: Figure 7 and Figure 8 are read in the sentences that follow their pointers, and Figure 9's reading ('the multi-workforce, the number of products, and the maintenance rate get the lowest points respectively') is printed in the same paragraph as its pointer, ABOVE the radar [mention.trail_sentence] [mention.read_sentences].

Ink families run node-link-network 5, flowchart-or-schematic 3, other 1, line 1, plus six grids: the paper's whole visual language is nodes-and-arrows - three indicator stars, the PageRank graph, a birth-death chain, a four-process cascade, a two-group data network - and the one radar row is other because the closed list has no radial entry [geometry.family].

Nothing is drawn in depth and nothing prints a colour bar: Figure 5's storage cylinder is the only solid-looking mark and its top and bottom ellipses are decoration, not projection [geometry.three_d] [geometry.colorbar].

Keys are absent on the figures: eight of ten print no key at all, and the two that do are both panels of Figure 10, which key their three curves inside the frame - one panel top-right, the other top-left - and neither caption mentions a key. Sixteen of the seventeen label-carrying coloured plates leave their colour families unexplained (the green/magenta/blue clades of Figure 3, the two circle styles of Figure 7) [geometry.legend].

Printed numbers appear on only two rows, both of them plotted: Figure 9's radar rings and Figure 10's axis ticks; every flow chart, network and schematic prints labels but no values [geometry.printed_numbers] [geometry.data_labels].

Panel counts are drawn, not numbered: Figure 9's three radars live inside one measured region, so that row carries panel_count 3 and needs no exclusion, while Figure 10's three panels were boxed separately, so its row is panel (a) and the other two are excluded fragment-of-other [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.panel_layout].

The six grids split into two constructions: Tables 1 to 3 are booktabs (horizontal rules only, no verticals, no closing rule) and Tables 4 to 6 are boxed (every vertical and horizontal drawn); only the boxed three align their decimals, and only Table 1 was mis-typed by the text layer badly enough that the symbol/definition pairing must be read from the crop [table.rule_style] [table.decimal_aligned].

No grid carries zebra striping, merged cells, a diagonal header or units in its header row, and none continues onto a second page [table.zebra] [table.merged_cells] [table.diagonal_header] [table.units_in_header] [table.continued].
